facts.fact: The Cellule Filets sociaux coordinator said the government safety-net cash transfers are paid through two mechanisms, contracts with microfinance institutions and with mobile telephone operators, while in Bahr El Gazal the agency Express Union pays the transfer in cash.

facts.fact: The coordinator of the Filets sociaux said 87,500 new households of Kanem and Bahr El Gazal were registered in the Registre social unique in 2024, a registry the World Bank financed through the Filets sociaux and whose indicators on vulnerable households are available by province.
